# SET UP DIRECTORIES
```{r}
setwd('/project/Neuroinformatics_Core/Roberts_lab/s433904/PalliumEvo_paper')
root_dir <- '/project/Neuroinformatics_Core/Roberts_lab/s433904/PalliumEvo_paper'

RDSfiles <- paste0(root_dir, "/RDS_files")
dir.create(RDSfiles, showWarnings = F)

dir.create(Figures_dir, showWarnings = F)

PaperFigs <- "/project/Neuroinformatics_Core/Roberts_lab/s433904/PalliumEvo_paper/Figures/Fig4_GabaClass"
```

# LOADING DATSETS
```{r}
seuObj <- readRDS("/project/Neuroinformatics_Core/Roberts_lab/s433904/PalliumEvo_AnalysisR/06_Taxonomy/AllenClustering/RDS_files/OutputUse/seuObj_iterCluster_clean_20250131.rds")

seuObj$clusterName3 <- factor(seuObj$clusterName3, levels = dendro_order_3)
Idents(seuObj) <- "clusterName3"

GABA_Clust <- seuObj$clusterName3[grepl("LGE|MGE|CGE", seuObj$clusterName3)] %>% unique()
Gaba_seu <- subset(seuObj, subset = clusterName3  %in% GABA_Clust)
Gaba_seu <- ScaleData(Gaba_seu, assay = "SCTorigIdent3", features = rownames(Gaba_seu))

Gaba_seuAvg <- AverageExpression(object = Gaba_seu, assays = "SCTorigIdent3", layer = "data", group.by = c('clusterName3'), return.seurat = T)

```

#============== Making figs ==========================================##########
##-- Can Markers and distribution (Panel A)

###-- Markers dot plot
```{r}
TFs2Plot <- GabaDEGs_roc$gene[GabaDEGs_roc$gene %in% TFs] %>% unique()
genes2Plot <- c(TFs2Plot, gabaMarkers[!gabaMarkers %in% TFs2Plot])
clusteredByGenes <- Clustered_DotPlot(Gaba_seu, features = genes2Plot, cluster_ident = F, flip = T)

# get clustered gene order
col_order <- clusteredByGenes[[2]]@ht_list[["matrix_8"]]@column_order_list[[1]]
clustered_gene_names <- colnames(clusteredByGenes[[2]]@ht_list[["matrix_8"]]@matrix)[col_order]

# manually arrange feature order, minimal since they are already cluteres
orderedGenes <- c(
                  ## CGE
                  "LAMP5", "TRPS1", # LAMP5 markers
                 
                  "MEF2C",
                  "ETV1", "HMGA2",
                  "LHX8", "SOX5", "THRB", 
                  "DPF3", "SP8", "PENK", "NR2E1",  #SNCG/VIP
                  "CNR1", "NR2F2",
                  "ADARB2",
                  
                  ## MGE
                   "SST", "NPY",  "CHODL", "ALKAL1", #sst

                   "PVALB", "ADSS1",
                  "MAF", "NXPH1",
                  
                  "ST18", "NFIA", "PROX1", "RORA", "LHX6", "NFIB",
                  "SOX6",  "ZEB2", "ZNF536", 
                  "SETBP1", "SOX2",
                  
                  #LGE
                  "FOXP1", "PBX3", "FOXP2", "MEIS2", "MEIS1", "ZFHX4", "TSHZ1")

gaba_CanMrks_dot <- DotPlot_scCustom(Gaba_seu, features = rev(orderedGenes),
                                     #col.min = 0, col.max = 3, 
                                     dot.min = 0.01, dot.scale = 8,
                                     colors_use = colorRampPalette(c("#f0f0f0", "#020202"))(100)) +
      theme(
            axis.line = element_line(color = "#060606"),
            axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#060606"),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
            )


ggsave(filename = paste0(PaperFigs, "/dotplot_GabaCanMarkers_v2.svg"), plot = gaba_CanMrks_dot,
       width = 11, height = 4.5)



```

###-- Region distribution stackplot
```{r}
Gaba_seu_meta <- FetchData(Gaba_seu, vars = c("orig.ident", "RegionAcronym", "clusterName3"))
Gaba_seu_meta$RegionAcronym <- factor(Gaba_seu_meta$RegionAcronym, levels = lvl_order)
Gaba_seu_meta$orig.ident <- factor(Gaba_seu_meta$orig.ident, levels = origIdent_lvls)

custom_colors <- c("#6F6F6F", "#7A5030FF", "#706543FF", "#1F593BFF", "#547B4FFF", "#6F97A8FF", "#486688FF", "#47477CFF", "#C8533AFF", "#D2BC6FFF")

stck <- stackedbarplot_colors(Gaba_seu_meta, "clusterName3", "RegionAcronym")
ggsave(filename = paste0(PaperFigs, "/stackplot_GABAcluster_byRgn.svg"), plot = stck,
       width = 10, height = 7)


stck_supp <- stackedbarplot_colors(Gaba_seu_meta, "clusterName3", "orig.ident", custom_colors = origIdent_colors)
ggsave(filename = paste0(PaperFigs_supp, "/stackplot_GABAcluster_byOridIdent.svg"), plot = stck_supp,
       width = 15, height = 7)

```



#============ SUPPLEMENTARY FIGS ==========================================#####
# HeatMap
```{r}
hMap <- DoHeatmap(subset(Gaba_seu, downsample = 200), features = GabaDEGs_roc$gene, # smallest cluster has ~250
                  assay = "SCTorigIdent3",
                  group.colors = c("#a0acff", "#5552d5",
                             sample(colorRampPalette(c("#c3f1fc", "#1f65b5"))(12)),
                             sample(colorRampPalette(c("#76d8bb", "#529e9a"))(5))
                           ),
              angle = 90, size = 2)

ggsave(filename = paste0(PaperFigs_supp, "/heatmap_GABAcluster_ROCmrks.tiff"), plot = hMap,
       width = 6, height = 40)

```
Using ROC to find the Genes makes a cleaner looking plot.
Also, choosing the top 50 ROC is already close to getting all the genes found,
  so will just use all of them.
  
top <- GabaDEGs_roc %>% 
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  arrange(desc(power)) %>%
  slice_head(n = nUse) %>%
  ungroup()

Downsampled from 1000 to 500 cells used still looks the same
